tested_scope: Exactly one bounded self-local control/state consistency check. The invocation compared the current SHA-pinned semantic authority tuple {DESIRED_STATE blob/control revision, multi_agent role-config blob/control/config revision, RUN_LIFECYCLE blob/revision} with the tuple persisted in the immediate predecessor multi_agent LATEST. Only the main transport head identity was allowed to differ. No claim/update side effect, stale-CAS attempt, create-if-absent attempt, public source, other role, O/downstream state, scheduler state, external hosted coordination, or second semantic leaf was used. The Git commit message exposed by head lookup was treated as forbidden unrelated transport metadata and was not consumed semantically.

claim_epoch_derivation.rule: Mechanical role-local checkpoint lineage only: successor observes explicit predecessor claim_epoch=n, sets n+1, and CAS-updates LATEST from that exact predecessor blob.

observations: The current SHA-pinned semantic authority is DESIRED_STATE control27 blob 0eee15a94c23400653d84506da1f795081a6ef24 and multi_agent config10/control13 blob 37a44cd0a2556a782247210bdd2c557ee58fe133 under RUN_LIFECYCLE revision3 blob 560024d46b6c26ea63ab58137be9d48863cab941.
The required config10 presemantic role-local witness was written and exact-read back before the semantic state read.
The immediate predecessor LATEST persisted the same root, role-config, lifecycle blobs and parsed revisions, while its frozen main-ref SHA differed from the current head.
No tested claim/update side effect was executed and no unrelated Git metadata was used as semantic evidence.
inference: For this exact predecessor/current pair, checkpoint reconstruction correctly distinguishes semantic authority identity from unrelated repository-head movement: the semantic tuple replayed identically even though the transport head changed. This narrows one stale-state failure mode in which unrelated main movement could otherwise be mistaken for a semantic-control change and trigger duplicate or conflicting recovery work. It does not prove stale-CAS rejection, create-if-absent duplicate rejection, simultaneous-writer exclusion, fairness, lease expiry/reclamation, or rate-limit interruption safety.

Test create-if-absent duplicate rejection only when the rejected attempt and durable result checkpoint can both fit within the bounded write budget.
